value.kbd_note: The Finder is the only shell; key proof is a menu, a selection or a dialog, never a prompt. Cmd-O on a selected icon is the cheapest visible chord
value.note: relative USB HID pointer: cursor_scale 5.5556 (guest gain exactly 0.18 at Mouse tracking 'Very Slow', linear at every chunk size 1..32). No exec channel - classic Mac OS has no shell at all

labctl.notes: no exec channel: Mac OS 9 has no shell, no telnet and no serial console - the framebuffer is the only observation surface. NO NIC by operator scope (ordinary station, no retronet). Warm reset is BROKEN on -M mac99 (system_reset hangs at the exception vector, NIP=0x4): reset is loadvm golden, cold boot is a fresh QEMU process, never system_reset.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# macos9 (slot 150) — the fleet's FIRST PowerPC station: qemu-system-ppc
#   -M mac99,via=pmu (Power Mac G4), Mac OS 9.2.2, from the kernel-hive QEMU
#   fork installed to /opt/qemu-ppc (pve-qemu ships no ppc target). TCG only.
#   via=pmu is MANDATORY (via=cuda breaks USB input) and the machine provides
#   its OWN USB kbd+mouse — adding -device usb-kbd/usb-mouse splits input
#   routing across two HID mice and clicks go nowhere. NO NIC (-nic none),
#   deliberately: no retronet, no networking, by operator scope.
#   RELATIVE USB HID pointer — Mac OS 9 has no usb-tablet driver; tracking
#   pinned 'Very Slow' = linear 0.18 px/unit, hence SH_CURSOR_SCALE=5.5556.

deviceSetSummary: -nic none (deliberate: no networking on this station)
(built-in via=pmu USB keyboard + USB mouse; NO extra -device usb-kbd/usb-mouse)

launcherParity.reason: tracked verbatim launcher IS the deployed launcher; the golden was re-baked cold 2026-08-24 by checkpoint-guard with this exact device set on the standalone /opt/qemu-ppc build carrying the cpu/tb_env vmstate patch (fork 196124d) — a pre-patch golden wedges on every restore

reset.fixture: Quiet Mac OS 9.2.2 Finder desktop at 1024x768, millions of colors (Power Mac G4 mac99 under TCG): Macintosh HD top-right, empty Trash bottom-right, no window open, nothing selected, Control Strip along the bottom, cursor parked dead-centre (512,384). Energy Saver sleep pinned to Never; Mouse tracking pinned to 'Very Slow' (the only non-accelerated setting, linear 0.18 px/unit) and double-click speed slowest so a click pair survives the stream; Setup Assistant quit and disarmed. Re-baked cold 2026-08-24 on the tb_env-patched fork binary and captured by checkpoint-guard; restore-proven by the strict protocol — fresh QEMU process, the guest's own menubar clock advancing across two ticks, then pointer motion consumed on the framebuffer (SSIM alone passes on a wedged guest and proves nothing).

museum.blurb: The last classic Mac OS — the platinum desktop Apple shipped alongside early Mac OS X, still with one menu bar, no protected memory, and the Finder as the whole machine.
museum.notes: The lineup's first PowerPC guest, and the end of the line that macos753 begins: the same Finder lineage five years and one architecture later. No networking, deliberately.

emulator.source: github.com/Wnt/qemu @ kernel-hive (11.0.2 + fast-poll + cpu/tb_env vmstate), built to /opt/qemu-ppc

network.note: NO NIC AT ALL (-nic none, which suppresses QEMU's default user-mode sungem on mac99). Operator scope for this add: ordinary station first — no retronet, no networking. The guest's TCP/IP and AppleTalk control panels were never configured. The golden is baked with this device set; adding a NIC later means a cold re-bake (chokanji/macos753 pattern).
